meta.disclaimer: Travel conditions can change after publication. Open the linked source before booking or crossing a border.
meta.emptyMessage: There are no current verified updates for this filter. That means we have nothing recent enough to publish — not that conditions cannot change.

updates.title: Lake of Stars 2026 postponed to 2027
updates.summary: Organisers have postponed the 2026 festival. Do not build an October 2026 itinerary around the previously announced dates; wait for the replacement 2027 dates before booking.

updates.title: MTN Bushfire confirms its 2027 weekend
updates.summary: The next festival is scheduled for 28–30 May 2027. Travellers pairing Eswatini with Kruger should reserve accommodation early and recheck the organiser before paying.

updates.title: Namibia entry rules require a fresh passport check
updates.summary: Namibia's visa regime changed on 1 April 2025 for affected nationalities. Use the official visa-on-arrival portal and confirm your passport's current requirement before departure.

updates.title: Check Lesotho's visa channel before applying
updates.summary: Lesotho's Home Affairs e-services notice says the eVisa service is suspended. Travellers who require a visa should follow the ministry's current instructions rather than relying on older eVisa links.
